title: acostaea costaricensis subsp. bicornis
intro: Acostaea costaricensis subsp. bicornis, commonly known as Bicornis, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bicornis include the potential treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents, which include annonaceous acetogenins, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Bicornis are responsible for its therapeutic actions, providing antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and microbial infections.
